title: Explicit dual pairing of a bounded finite-projective cochain complex
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $P^\bullet$ an integer cochain complex [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], zero outside $[a,b]$ for integers $a\le b$, whose terms are finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Define $D^n=\operatorname{Hom}_A(P^{-n},A)$ and $d_D^n(\phi)=(-1)^{n+1}\phi\circ d_P^{-n-1}$. This is a cochain complex, zero outside $[-b,-a]$, with finitely generated projective terms. For the direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and the unit complex $A[0]$, there are chain maps $\epsilon:D\otimes_A P\to A[0]$ and $\eta:A[0]\to P\otimes_A D$: $\epsilon$ on $D^{-n}\otimes_A P^n$ is $\phi\otimes x\mapsto\phi(x)$, and the degree-zero component of $\eta(1)$ in $P^n\otimes_A\operatorname{Hom}_A(P^n,A)$ is the tensor corresponding to $\operatorname{id}_{P^n}$ under $P^n\otimes_A\operatorname{Hom}_A(P^n,A)\cong\operatorname{End}_A(P^n)$. All other components are zero. These maps satisfy $(1_P\otimes\epsilon)\circ(\eta\otimes1_P)=1_P$ and $(\epsilon\otimes1_D)\circ(1_D\otimes\eta)=1_D$, with the canonical associators and unitors.
